about: A tool that finds the changed lines in a branch that have no test coverage.

prs.title: LCOV reports work from a subfolder
prs.broken: Run from a subfolder of the repo, diff-cover matched no files in an LCOV report and passed a coverage check it should have failed.
prs.changed: Paths in LCOV reports are now read from the folder the tool ran in, or as absolute paths.
prs.matters: Coverage gates on LCOV reports catch untested code again.

prs.title: Java coverage reports work when run from a subfolder
prs.broken: Running diff-cover with a JaCoCo report from a Java module's own folder, the usual monorepo layout, matched no files, reported no coverage and passed the check.
prs.changed: Report paths are now matched relative to where the tool runs, including on Windows and with source root options.
prs.matters: Coverage checks in multi-module Java repos actually catch untested changes.
